coverage: SQLite turn persistence and reopening after database reinitialization
Source-field allowlist; image-path and metadata fields are excluded
Conversation listing, rename, delete and message cascade deletion
Message retention keeps the newest complete question/answer turns
Persistence after stopping and restarting the FastAPI process against the same temporary database

browser_smoke.application: Real local FastAPI app and frontend at 127.0.0.1:8766
browser_smoke.database: Unique temporary SQLite file; no project/user chat database used
browser_smoke.provider_call: Stubbed at the browser network boundary; no Groq/OpenAI request
steps: Submit a chat question through the UI and persist the resulting answer/source through the normal frontend flow
Reload the page and verify the conversation appears in saved history
Reopen the conversation and verify answer and source excerpt are restored
Delete the conversation and verify it disappears

server_restart_smoke.database: Same unique temporary SQLite file before and after process restart
server_restart_smoke.verified: Saved answer and source excerpt were readable after restarting FastAPI

implementation_notes.scope: Text, assistant answer and allowlisted citation/source metadata only; X-ray image, filename, case metadata and case id are not saved to chat history
implementation_notes.deployment_limit: Single-user loopback demo; no app-level encryption, user accounts or automatic backup/restore
implementation_notes.manual_acceptance_on_user_machine: Still recommended after restart of the user's VS Code run configuration
